intro: Tell your mother about your day, from morning until night.

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: What time do you wake up in the morning?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what time you wake up.
expected: I wake up at six o'clock.
I wake up at seven in the morning.
conversation.hint: Try: "I wake up at six o'clock."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: Good habit! What do you do after that?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: I brush my teeth and take a bath.
I wash my face and get ready.
conversation.hint: Try: "I brush my teeth and take a bath."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: And what do you eat for breakfast?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say what you eat for breakfast.
expected: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
conversation.hint: Try: "I eat bread and eggs for breakfast."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: When do you do your homework?

conversation.speaker: student
conversation.prompt: Say when you do your homework.
expected: I do my homework in the evening.
I do my homework after school.
I finish my homework at five.
conversation.hint: Try: "I do my homework in the evening."

conversation.speaker: mother
conversation.text: Very good. And what time do you go to bed?

conversation.speaker: student
expected: I go to bed at nine o'clock.
I go to sleep at nine.
conversation.hint: Try: "I go to bed at nine o'clock."
